title: Treatment with acetylcholine esterase inhibitors in anorexia nervosa : a multicenter double-blind randomised controlled trial versus placebo
official: Treatment with acetylcholine esterase inhibitors in anorexia nervosa : a multicenter double-blind randomised controlled trial versus placebo
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the effect, compared with placebo, of oral administration of donepezil (an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor) on improvement in the symptomatology of anorexia nervosa.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. female
2. Presence of 3 DSM V criteria for anorexia nervosa
3. Restrictive subtype of anorexia nervosa
4. Body Mass Index between 14 and 18.5 kg/m2
5. Aged between 18 and 65
6. Resting heart rate greater than or equal to 40 bpm
Exclusion criteria:
1. Past diagnosis of anorexia nervosa in the form of hyperphagia/purgation
2. Pregnant or breast-feeding women
3. Past diagnosis of bulimia nervosa
4. Past diagnosis of binge eating disorder
5. Comorbid diagnosis of psychotic disorder and/or bipolar disorder
6. Renal impairment (glomerular filtration rate less than 60 mL/min according to the MDRD formula)
7. Liver failure or transaminase elevation greater than 5N
8. Electrocardiogram of conduction disorder
9. Taking a psychotropic drug now or in the three weeks prior to inclusion (including antidepressants, to avoid interaction/potentiation in this population)
10. Taking a treatment involving the following cytochromes : P450, P3A4, P2D6
